items.title: Cripple a Super Mutant's Arm
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center and use V.A.T.S. to target the arm.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Check Pip-Boy map for gray cloudy area, fast travel and locate the red circle hotspot.

items.title: Craft Fish Bits
items.detail: Process caught fish at a Cooking Station; small fish yield 1, medium yield 2, large yield 5.

items.title: Deal Fire Damage to Enemies
items.detail: Use a Flamer or fire weapons; Whitespring Golf Club has low-level Ghouls for fast kills.

items.title: Eat a Fish Bit
items.detail: Craft Fish Bits at a Cooking Station from caught fish, then eat them.

items.title: Eat a box of Sugar Bombs
items.detail: Find at New River Gorge Bridge - West under the bridge, or collect from Santatron/Fasnacht Collectron.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while on a Team and wearing a Costume
items.detail: Join a team, equip any costume item, find Phantoms at Kiddie Corner Cabins or other locations.

items.title: Build a Floor, Wall, or Roof in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Enter build menu and construct basic wood or concrete floors, then scrap them.

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is reliable with no enemies.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Locate and fully clear an infestation hotspot for rare 4-Star legendary loot.

items.title: Craft Fish Bits
items.detail: Process caught fish at a Cooking Station.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for dependable robot spawns.

items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Consume items like BlamCo Mac and Cheese, Dandy Boy Apples, or Pork n' Beans.

items.title: Kill a Floater
items.detail: Go to Solomon's Pond and use V.A.T.S. to target the eyes as the weak spot.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find Phantoms during an active infestation hotspot encounter.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night event and stay in Vertibot area for Phantom spawn.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Community building contest inspired by slasher movies with Atom and title rewards.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Pint-Sized Phantom encounters and exclusive rewards.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring spooky-themed Scorched enemies and limited-time rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Double experience points awarded for all activities throughout the weekend.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance of catching seasonal fish species during this weekend event.
